purpose: Establish 10 fast-variable risk gates that can dynamically reduce G18 base_score and veto PAPER_TRACK. These gates evaluate real-time price action, volume behavior, and structural breakdowns that slow variables cannot capture.
design_principle: Slow variables (lineage, cycle, horizon) provide base_score. Fast variables own action gate veto power. A single CRITICAL gate or multiple HIGH gates can force paper_track_allowed=false regardless of base_score.

risk_gates.name: Volume Climax
risk_gates.rationale: Extreme volume often marks distribution tops or panic capitulation. Either way, conviction should decrease.

risk_gates.name: Long Upper Shadow
risk_gates.rationale: Long upper shadow indicates strong selling pressure at higher prices. Intraday rejection of upside.

risk_gates.name: Cost Line Break
risk_gates.rationale: Price below user's cost basis creates floating loss. Psychology shifts from profit-taking to loss-avoidance.

risk_gates.name: D1 Support Break
risk_gates.rationale: Breaking daily chart support invalidates the prior structural thesis.

risk_gates.name: Cycle Origin Break
risk_gates.rationale: Price below cycle origin means the entire up-cycle thesis is invalidated. Most severe structural failure short of CRITICAL.

risk_gates.name: Multi Support Break (Compound)
risk_gates.rationale: Two or more structural supports broken simultaneously = cascading failure. Highest severity — immediate action gate closure.
risk_gates.note: Compound gate — triggers only when underlying R3/R4/R5 conditions are met. Penalty is NOT additive with individual R3/R4/R5 penalties; it REPLACES them.

risk_gates.name: Event Risk Window
risk_gates.rationale: During known event windows (earnings, regulatory, macro announcements), absent confirmation signals mean elevated uncertainty.

risk_gates.name: Sector Rotation Fade
risk_gates.rationale: Sector losing relative momentum. Capital rotating away. Even fundamentally sound stocks lose bid support.

risk_gates.name: Market Style Headwind
risk_gates.rationale: Stock's style factor (growth/value/small/large) in persistent headwind. Structural drag reduces probability of near-term outperformance.

risk_gates.name: Catalyst Decay Expired
risk_gates.condition: days_since_catalyst > threshold AND no catalyst refresh
risk_gates.rationale: Original catalyst has expired without renewal. Stock is now trading on inertia, not thesis. Maps to ZC35 factor.

severity_hierarchy.CRITICAL: Immediate action gate closure. paper_track_allowed=false. final_score_cap=40.
severity_hierarchy.HIGH: Strong downward pressure. Two or more HIGH → action gate closure.
severity_hierarchy.MEDIUM: Moderate caution. Accumulates penalty but does not independently close gate.

compound_rules.condition: Any single gate at CRITICAL severity triggered
Two or more HIGH severity gates triggered

compound_rules.effect: Cannot upgrade to PAPER_TRACK. Maximum action=WAIT or OBSERVE.

input_contract.missing_field_policy: If a required field is None/missing, the corresponding gate is SKIPPED (not triggered). Optional fields default to non-triggering state.

fields.triggered_gates: List of gate IDs that fired
fields.max_severity: Highest severity among triggered gates (CRITICAL > HIGH > MEDIUM > NONE)
fields.total_penalty: Sum of score penalties (with compound rule dedup)
fields.paper_track_allowed: Boolean — false if any compound rule or severity threshold fires
fields.gate_details: Per-gate trigger details for audit trail
